development.strategy: CommandLineTools-compatible local development uses scripts/aura-test.sh; full Xcode is preferred when available.

release.strategy: Use full Xcode, Developer ID signing, notarization, Gatekeeper validation, and the exact packaged artifact.

observed.hardware_profile: Apple Silicon MacBook Air; 16 GiB unified memory profile

python.system: Python 3.14.6 is observed but is not the Chatterbox runtime.
python.repository_validation: Python standard library only; no network installation is required.
python.chatterbox: Runtime/chatterbox is installed with Python 3.11.15 under AURA Application Support.

models.manifest_policy: Runtime requires AURA_MODEL_MANIFEST.json and recomputes SHA-256 and byte length before loading; model weights remain outside git.

compatibility_policy.development: Swift 6.4, arm64, and macOS SDK 27.0 are the observed supported baseline; lower versions fail validation until separately audited.
compatibility_policy.release: Full Xcode, Developer ID, notarization, and clean-machine Gatekeeper evidence are mandatory; local/ad-hoc signing is not release evidence.
compatibility_policy.projection_commits: verified_head identifies the audited code/evidence baseline. A later HEAD is allowed only when the descendant diff contains projection-only files; state-only commits must not change product claims without a new audit.
compatibility_policy.deprecation: When Swift, SDK, Python, model, or CLI baselines change, update this manifest and ADR-045, rerun the validator, and append evidence before changing CI.

limitations: The observed host has Apple CommandLineTools 27.0 beta 5 but no active Xcode/xcodebuild.
swift-format is available only through the active xcrun toolchain; its observed --version output is main rather than an independent semantic version.

SwiftLint 0.65.0 is provisioned through Homebrew, but its SourceKit-backed mode cannot load sourcekitd under the observed CommandLineTools-only developer directory; the --disable-sourcekit result is partial and is not a full lint pass.
No CI workflow run was observed during this local validation; workflow configuration is not CI execution evidence.
The Package.swift deployment target remains macOS 27 because no availability audit supports lowering it.
